correctness.rationale: Kernel and Hilbert-Schmidt integral computed exactly. Smooth local Volterra order-two Weyl lemma reconstructed by fourth-order integration spectrum, finite-rank interval decompositions and an H³ smoothing remainder. Low-block dilation factor delta^alpha and cross-block rank ≤2 yield a geometric singular-count recurrence. The exact resulting constant is 2/(pi sqrt(alpha)) in counting and 4/(pi² alpha) for n²s_n; compact Volterra eigenvalue argument gives quasinilpotence, and Lidskii gives trace zero. Exact finite arithmetic tests corroborate identities, not the infinite limit.

value.rationale: A full exact Weyl singular-value constant for a canonical Hardy averaging commutator, valid across the singular origin for every alpha>0, is a motivated structural invariant. It fixes the sharp quasi-Schatten critical endpoint and isolates the singular boundary contribution by a self-similar rank-two recursion. The coefficient diverges as alpha tends to zero although the alpha=0 commutator vanishes, exposing a mathematically meaningful nonuniform scale rather than a routine isolated case.
